info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tennant Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tennant Laptop Details Management API enables users to add detailed specifications and information about tennant laptops to the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance their inventory data, ensuring that all relevant details are captured systematically. Developers can utilize this API to streamline catalog management processes, particularly in environments requiring precise laptop configurations and specifications. Typical consumers include inventory managers and e-commerce platforms looking to improve accurate product representation.

post.summary: Create laptop details for a tenant.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store detailed information about a laptop associated with a specific tenant. Providing relevant details helps in maintaining organized records and facilitating better asset management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a tenant laptop. It includes specific attributes required for processing the tenant laptop information such as model, specifications, and any associated metadata.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the laptop details.

tennant_laptop_id.description: The unique identifier for the tenant laptop.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the tenant laptop.

quantity.description: The number of tenant laptops requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the tenant laptop.

supplier.description: Details about the supplier providing the tenant laptop.

CreateCatalogTennantLaptopDetailRequest.description: Request body for operations related to tenant laptop details.

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier is verified.

SupplierDetails.description: Information about the supplier providing products.

email.description: The email address of the supplier's contact.

phone.description: The phone number of the supplier's contact.

ContactDetails.description: Contact information for reaching the supplier.

CreateCatalogTennantLaptopDetailResponse.title: Tenant Laptop Details Response

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record created or updated.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing was completed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

CreateCatalogTennantLaptopDetailResponse.description: Response schema for the Tenant Laptop Details operation after a successful POST request.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource in the response. Commonly used types include 'application/json' for JSON data.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. Useful for performance tracking.
